items.title: 'Oudjes' Linssen (35) en Tadic (37) zorgen voor fraaie mijlpaal deze eeuw
items.summary: NEC speelde dinsdagavond om 19.30 uur de return van de derde voorronde in de Champions League tegen Olympiakos Piraeus. Door de 0-0 van vorige week was de Champions League-droom van de Nijmegenaren nog springlevend. En die krijgt volgende week een vervolg! Je miste niets van het duel in deze VI Live.

items.title: Schreuder ziet ook Sandler wegvallen voor tweeluik met Bodø/Glimt
items.summary: NEC moet de weg naar de Champions League-hoofdfase afmaken zonder Philippe Sandler, zo verwacht trainer Dick Schreuder. Het vroege wisselen van zijn verdediger was niet gepland.

items.title: NEC laat Nederland dromen van mega-coëfficiëntenbonus
items.summary: Door de zege van NEC kan Nederland weer wat coëfficiëntpunten bijschrijven. Het is geen vetpot, maar omdat de competitiefase van de Champions League nog in zicht is, lonkt er een behoorlijke bonus.

items.title: Griekse pers looft Bischop voor spel in Nijmeegse 'vrieskou'
items.summary: In de Griekse pers wordt verslagen gereageerd op de Champions League-eliminatie van Olympiakos Piraeus door NEC . De Nijmeegse spelers krijgen links en rechts lof toegezwaaid van de Zuid-Europese collega's, die het in Gelderland qua weer hoogst onaangenaam vonden.

items.title: Nejasmic over gemis Sano en aanwinst Tadic: 'I love it!'
items.summary: Darko Nejasmic speelde een ijzersterke wedstrijd tegen Olympiakos en had een groot aandeel in de 2-1 overwinning, waardoor NEC mag blijven dromen van de Champions League. Hij sprak over het gemis van Sano, een mogelijke transfer en de komst van Dusan Tadic.

items.title: ‘I am quite optimistic’: Newcastle’s Jaissle on leading club after turbulent summer
items.summary: The former Al-Ahli head coach, chosen by the Saudi owners to replace Eddie Howe, admits ‘vacuum’ after sale of three key players Matthias Jaissle has been described as “fire” and a “rockstar”, but his formal “unveiling” as Newcastle’s manager revealed a rather more considered and conservative character than advertised. At the precise moment the clock struck 3pm on Tuesday the 38‑year‑old German walked into a packed media suite at St James’ Park. Before taking his seat on the stage Jaissle, wearing a smartly understated open-necked suit complete with a silk pocket square, took a deep breath and jumped down into audience, making a point of shaking everyone’s hand. It was a courteous and classy gesture. Continue reading...

items.title: Jaissle 'bit scared' how refs will take 'emotional' touchline style
items.summary: Newcastle United head coach Matthias Jaissle cut a measured figure at his unveiling news conference, but Premier League managers will come up against someone very different

items.title: Infantino’s opponents developing new framework for running world football
items.summary: Uefa, Concacaf and AFC working together on system Fifa has ignored calls for an independent review Gianni Infantino’s opponents are working together to produce a new framework for running world football to replace what they regard as a system of patronage that Fifa has adopted since he replaced Sepp Blatter as president 10 years ago. Repeated calls from Uefa, Concacaf and the Asian Football Confederation for an independent review of Fifa’s governance have been ignored by Infantino since his plan to sell off 21% of the World Cup was made public a fortnight ago, and the rebels are now understood to have taken matters into their own hands. Continue reading...

items.title: Djed Spence nears Tottenham exit with Inter in talks over £25.6m move
items.summary: England defender keen on move to Italian champions Udogie and Porro set to be Spurs’ first-choice full-backs Tottenham are prepared to allow Djed Spence to join Inter, with the England defender expected to cost around €30m (£25.6m). Spence – who started four games at the World Cup, including the semi-final against Argentina – has fallen further down the pecking order at Spurs after the arrival of Andy Robertson from Liverpool. He signed a new four‑year contract in north London at the start of last season but is believed to be keen on joining the Italian champions, with Destiny Udogie and Pedro Porro expected to be Roberto De Zerbi’s preferred full‑backs this season. Continue reading...

items.summary: Chelsea also made aware of 19-year-old’s availability Newcastle’s Lewis Hall remains prime United target Myles Lewis-Skelly has been offered to Manchester United as a potential left-back option, with Arsenal wishing to recoup some of the £75m paid to Newcastle for Bruno Guimarães. Chelsea, it is understood, have also been made aware of the 19-year-old’s availability. Lewis-Skelly won the Premier League under Mikel Arteta last term, but whether the west London club will make a move for him is unclear. Continue reading...
